required_nodes.rationale: A state-root parent replaced with a symlink between validation and descriptor acquisition must fail before lock creation or watchdog invocation.
Once the state directory is opened, replacing its path ancestry cannot redirect lock or journal operations to the replacement target.
A lock leaf replaced with a symlink is rejected before any scheduler action.
A journal leaf replaced with a symlink is rejected before watchdog invocation or external-file mutation.
A stop-marker leaf replaced with a symlink is rejected rather than read through the link.
The existing successful cadence path still records a durable receipt and invokes the watchdog once.
